checks.detail: Bounded 10 USDT stock-token execution succeeded; post-swap allowance is zero.
Three BNB Chain contracts have matching receipts, runtime bytecode, relationships, and BscScan sources.
The live EIP-712 Credential is bound to the deployed ContinuityRegistry and deployment evidence root.
The Passport exposes quoteFresh as the sole challenge instead of inferring an unprovable broadcast time.
An independent consumer permits monitoring but blocks deposits and automated rescue.
Public summary roots match deployment, Credential, Passport, and consumer artifacts.
The wallet-free browser verifier independently recomputes all published roots.
Wallets, agents, and protocols can integrate without importing the UI.
The official BNB Agent Studio A2A/X402 workspace is deployed in the managed BSC Testnet trial with fixed 0.01 U pricing.
OAuth-protected public A2A negotiation returned an accepted quote whose provider signature recovers to the deployed Agent wallet.
An independent buyer funded Job 1254 with 0.01 U and the public Agent submitted a content-addressed PROTECTED decision on-chain.
The seller runtime is BSC Testnet-bound, has no LLM pricing or delivery path, and tests PROTECTED, WATCH, RESCUE_REQUIRED, BLOCKED, no-signing, and no-transaction outcomes.
Tests, compilation, package build, security audit, and this readiness audit run in CI.
No credential or private-key pattern is present in public artifacts.

payload.truthNotice: TECHNICALLY_READY covers the reproducible repository, public demo, mainnet execution, source-verified contracts, Registry-bound Credential, Passport, independent consumer, managed Agent Studio trial, authenticated signed public quote, and a real independent-buyer ERC-8183 delivery submitted on-chain. It does not claim final buyer settlement, B402 settlement, or a completed submission video.
